response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), grp AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), q AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_modindex, g.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_overall_avg, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q
